purpose: Misthalin permanent skilling unlocks missing from prior regional skilling enrichment: Fort Forinthry workshops, City of Um necromancy/RC infrastructure, Archaeology campus, Runespan portal, diary utility, and Infernal Source dig-site access. Fills ironman-guide gaps called out for Fort kitchen/chapel, necromantic runecrafting, and Underworld Grimoire supply loops.

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in the current planner taxonomy. region_hints marks a cross-region chain. Fort Forinthry and City of Um use the historical Catalyst Misthalin working mapping until Equilibrium publishes a different locality boundary. Quest auto-completion and League-specific overrides must be applied separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise unlocks that materially change self-sufficient progression, training throughput, supply access, or tool progression. Do not mirror every shop item.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets; this file records unlock state and effects.
policy.skip_rule: Skip pure combat BiS (Rasial gear, EGWD uniques already in major-upgrades/combat rows). Include Slayer Guardhouse only as Fort skilling-adjacent infrastructure, not weapon/armour BiS.
